relationship: Wiring devices and choosing checks connects transmission media, topology and error-control choices to received data.

learnerLoop.action: Add devices, connect ports and choose conductor and checking methods.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The network layout, wire paths and protocol settings change.
learnerLoop.evidence: The live status, signal effects and controls reveal connection and transmission consequences.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Rewire or change checking to improve the outcome.

invariants: Transmission evidence is based on the devices, ports and protocol options currently selected.
A wire connection remains visible as a path between its endpoints.
safeAdaptations: Change device scenarios, interference conditions or guidance while preserving the editable network and observable consequences.
nonGoals: Providing a full network design or cabling tool.

task.description: Conductor and explicit Off/Echo/Parity menus below the goal bar.
task.visibility: Present throughout; content follows the current simulation state.

model.description: Editable device bytes and ports, offset-preserving device dragging with release/cancel cleanup, TX/RX links and interference.
model.visibility: Present throughout; content follows the current simulation state.

evidence.description: Transmission mode, received bytes and checking/interference results.
evidence.visibility: Present throughout; content follows the current simulation state.

controls.description: Add a device, straighten or match selected wiring, remove a wire, reset.
controls.visibility: Present throughout; content follows the current simulation state.

byte.source: Editable generated TX bit cells and simulation arrivals.

ports.domain: Zero to nine ports; at most five devices.
ports.output: Device port bank and mode label.

distance.description: Conductor path lengths and relative interference proximity.
distance.domain: Canvas-derived distance; displayed metres and relative positions.
distance.source: Device positions, wire bends and noise-source position.
distance.output: Wire group labels and weak/lost/skew/crosstalk effects.

modes.wire: Basic or braided copper; setting applies when constructing/changing selected wiring.
modes.checking: Off, Echo or Parity in a labelled menu. Echo and parity require a return path.
modes.support: Continuous simulation; no Working or exam selection.

dependencies: TX must connect to RX; complete paths stream automatically.
Port counts and paths determine serial/parallel and simplex/duplex behaviour.
Noise and path properties influence received bit evidence.
implementation.completion: Open exploration with no scored completion gate; compare received data, repair paths and reset.
limitations: A teaching simulation with stylised conductor and interference effects.
Device status and register elements are generated; some selectors appear only after rendering.
